name: Unsettling Ululations (Recharge 6)
description: The stalk on the creature’s head unleashes a dispiriting wail. Each creature within 30 feet of the creature that can hear it must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 21 (6d6) psychic damage and is frightened for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn’t frightened. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
